notes:
Speed release:
- Camera alignment: uses all CPU cores, solves each step only as precisely as needed and stops when gains become negligible (about 2-3x faster)
- Exposure balance: seconds instead of minutes on big jobs
- Rendering: faster blending and better photo reuse, about 1.5-2x faster
- A crashed worker (e.g. low memory) now stops the job with a clear message instead of hanging
